package main
import("testing")
func BenchmarkRoomBroadcast35(b *testing.B){
 h:=newHub(1);g:=newGame(350);g.Rules.MapSize="large";ps:=testPlayers(4);g.startMatch(ps);r:=&Room{Game:g,Players:ps,Spectators:map[int]*Player{}}
 for _,p:=range ps {if p!=nil {p.Client=&Client{send:make(chan []byte,32),updates:make(chan []byte,1),done:make(chan struct{}),mapGeneration:g.Generation}}}
 for i:=0;i<16;i++ {id:=len(ps)+i;r.Spectators[id]=&Player{ID:id,Member:uint64(id+1),Spectating:true,Name:"WATCHER",Client:&Client{send:make(chan []byte,32),updates:make(chan []byte,1),done:make(chan struct{}),mapGeneration:g.Generation}}}
 for j:=0;j<12;j++ {g.Bullets=append(g.Bullets,&Bullet{ID:j,Owner:j%4,X:100,Y:100,VX:235,R:5,Life:4,Kind:"homing"})}
 b.ReportAllocs();b.ResetTimer()
 for i:=0;i<b.N;i++ {for _,p:=range r.members(){if p.Client!=nil{h.sendState(p.Client,r)}}}
}
